hooks.name: Check saved files for secret-looking strings
hooks.description: Scans any saved file under src, functions, scripts, data, tests, fixtures or the project root for patterns that look like API keys, bearer tokens or other secrets. Reports findings without storing them.

action.prompt: A file was just saved. Scan its content for secret-looking strings: bearer tokens (Bearer [A-Za-z0-9+/=_\-]{20,}), api_key or apikey assignments with a value, long hex strings (32+ hex chars), base64 blobs (40+ chars of [A-Za-z0-9+/=]), and any line that matches a common key pattern (sk-..., pk_..., ghp_..., xoxb-..., AKIA...). If you find any, list each match (truncated to 8 chars) and the line number. If the file contains none, say nothing.
